subject: Legal Studies
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Family Justice System in CBSE Class 11 Legal Studies.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Legal Studies (074), Unit-5: Family Justice System covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
